parsed.rationale: All four records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural similarity is purely that they are zero-field type aliases — not that they alias the same underlying type or carry the same domain semantics. `ApplicationWillTerminateMessage` (Core package), `PlaybackStalledMessage` and `HLSPlaybackStalledMessage` (Playback package), and `RequestSentMessage` (MusicShareKit package) each represent distinct domain events in unrelated subsystems. The `shared_field_count: 1` with `jaccard: null` and `differing_slots: null` confirms the pipeline matched on structural shape (empty-body type alias) rather than on any shared content. Extracting these to a common type would conflate unrelated message concepts and couple Core, Playback, and MusicShareKit around a meaningless shared ancestor.
